title: Nonvanishing of the projection off a unit vector
statement: Let $u$ and $v$ be unit vectors in a real inner product space, and suppose that $v \neq u$ and $v \neq -u$. Then the projection of $v$ onto the orthogonal complement of $\mathrm{span}\{u\}$, namely $v - \langle u,v\rangle\, u$, is nonzero.
replaced:
If $u$ and $v$ are unit vectors with $v 
eq u$ and $v 
eq -u$, then
$\mathrm{orthProj}(u,v) 
eq 0$.
